name: FactoryMethod
summary: Defines an interface for creating an object, but lets subclasses decide which class to instantiate, deferring instantiation to them.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Creator
roles.summary: Declares the factory method and, usually, calls it to obtain a product.

roles.name: ConcreteCreator
roles.summary: Overrides the factory method to return an instance of a concrete product.

roles.name: Product
roles.summary: Declares the interface of the objects the factory method creates.

roles.name: FactoryMethod
roles.summary: The operation that creates the product, and which subclasses override.
